description: Taskei P559182944 (review of CR-321561773, round 1, reviewer 1 B4): a workbook name X, defined through the API (Graph names/add) over S!$A$1:$A$3 after load, binds formulas that read it unresolved. Does each one spill, or intersect? C1 and C5 are file formulas (legacy, no cm): C1 on the range's rows, C5 off them. E1 and E5 are the same formula typed before the add. G1:G4 show how each reads after the add (FORMULATEXT: an @ means it intersects). The engine spills all four (docs/excel-semantics/references.md, 'A plain formula cell whose formula became an array spills').
